summary: Challenge to civilian powers granted to Smotrich as minister in the Defense Ministry; the May 10, 2023 ruling denied interim relief without reaching the merits.
notes: Completion audit preserves the previously recovered final merits disposition: on 2026-01-29 the High Court dismissed HCJ 2435/23 and the companion challenge after the state amended the arrangements. The judgment identified significant difficulties in the original institutional structure but held that later amendments cured the defects and did not assign Smotrich personal fault. Rejected/non-canonical under the individual-accountability threshold; exculpatory/corrective disposition preserved. Renewed May 2023 searches across Netanyahu, Smotrich, Ben-Gvir, other prominent current-right leaders, official/government, court/legal, Knesset and Comptroller/inquiry lanes found no additional concrete candidate meeting the library threshold.
